atoms.b: Most aquatic plants are completely submerged and ((++can cannot)) absorb water directly into their leaves and stems.

hint.text: If something is submerged, it is completely covered in water.
hint.label: Submerged

atoms.b: Some other aquatic plants, like ((++lily_pads cacti)), float and absorb water through their dangling roots.
Trees absorb water from the ((++soil air)) with their roots.
Trees are a lot larger than the average plant. This means that the water must travel a ((++greater smaller)) distance from the roots to the leaves.
Tree roots are much ((++larger smaller)) than those of other plants and spread out more. They also have to grow much ((++deeper shallower)) to keep the heavy tree anchored.
The tubes that transport the water in trees are found in the ((++bark moss)).
